page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmc5s.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture bare-metal server instance powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processors. The system features 96 dedicated vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz, paired with 192.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a resource allocation ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, aligning with compute-intensive hardware profiles.

The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. There are no integrated graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this server type.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high core density make this instance suitable for workloads requiring sustained, predictable compute performance without virtualization overhead. Appropriate workloads include high-performance computing, batch processing, compute-heavy web serving, and distributed analytics where local storage is not a primary requirement.
